headline: Godcrofts, Linn of Mercy Go Wholly Colonial as Night Toll Mounts
war_summary: Three hours on from our last edition, the night has redrawn several lines. Godcrofts, divided at the previous writing, now stands wholly Colonial, and the Linn of Mercy's last Warden work has gone to ruin, leaving ten Colonial holdings there. Fisherman's Row widened from a five-four edge to six-three Colonial, while Stlican Shelf ceded another work and now reads six Warden to three. The heaviest slaughter ran through Callahan's Passage and the Weathered Expanse: the former counted more than 10,000 Colonial and 7,600 Warden casualties over the day with losses still accelerating, the latter some 9,700 against 11,400, fifty-seven base actions recorded and firing as this edition closed. Stlican Shelf edged that figure with fifty-eight actions, though its pace now cools. Stonecradle has seen no base actions since shortly after midnight, yet its casualty rate climbs. The ledger stands at 292 Colonial works to 142 Warden, two in ruin, a net shift of eight since last we wrote. Elsewhere the front is still: most regions logged nothing, and Marban Hollow and Viper Pit have been quiet since yesterday. No victor is declared on the war's 227th day.
